newThreads.quote: per-round signed token in the URL fragment
newThreads.text: Prefer the token in a query param, not the fragment — the server never sees fragments, so it cannot enforce auth on first load.
Make detection overridable with an env var; auto-detection will misfire on tunneled setups.
Drop option A — our remote envs have no SSH endpoint.

overallComment: Good shape overall. Kill option A, tighten the token story, then I will approve.
